concerns.text: FR-008 lists three ablation dimensions — 'friction coefficient, elasticity, fluid dynamics' — but T009 sweeps only friction ∈ {0.2,0.5,0.8} and elasticity ∈ {0.1,0.5,0.9}. No task implements or explicitly narrows the fluid-dynamics axis, so part of FR-008 has no covering task.

FR-002 mandates a ≈50 M-parameter student; T002 specifies 'plan-scaled ~10 M params'. No task trains or justifies the 50 M architecture, and no spec amendment is referenced — the tasks as written cannot satisfy FR-002 as stated.

Spec edge case triggers the higher-LR fallback when 'validation MSE > 0.07 after 20 epochs', but T002/T005 cap training at ≤6 epochs, so the specified fallback condition can never fire. The epoch threshold needs a covering task or documented reconciliation.

T006 trains a control baseline and T007 requires 'metrics exist for every test sequence and model type' including control, but the evaluation_results schema's model_type enum allows only physics_teacher/neural_teacher. No task updates the contract, so control-baseline rows have no representable output and T012 contract tests will fail.
